notes: Printed: 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature card or GARRUK planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom ...'. 4 combat damage: look at the top four (Some Artifact, Garruk Unleashed, Basri Ket, Some Instant; Drawn Card went to hand in the opening draw). The only legal reveal is Garruk, Unleashed (Basri Ket is a non-Garruk planeswalker; the artifact and instant are not creature cards); it goes to hand, the other three stay in the library.
